_comment: Gold set for the EU Law Comply gap analyser. Each case pairs one requirement with one company document and the verdict a competent compliance reviewer would give. Labels are derived from VERBATIM statements in the document (quoted in `evidence_in_document`), not from anything the model produced -- otherwise the set would just encode the model's current behaviour. `difficulty` separates cases where the document states the position outright from ones needing judgement. v2 adds a SECOND company, Meridian, with a mature compliance programme: v1 was 10/20 'gap' and had a single 'met' case, so it measured 'does it find problems' far better than 'does it recognise compliance', and a model that simply distrusted every document would have scored well.

cases.evidence_in_document: In 2025 we destroyed 41,200 units, principally damaged returns and items withdrawn for safety reasons.
cases.rationale: Large enterprise (1,340 staff, EUR 310m turnover) destroying unsold apparel and footwear. The prohibition binds it from 19 July 2026 with no phase-in.

cases.evidence_in_document: We do not currently publish figures on discarded unsold products.
cases.rationale: Explicit non-compliance with the annual disclosure duty; the sustainability report does not break down units, weight, reasons or treatment split.

cases.evidence_in_document: We have not yet appointed authorised representatives in the Member States where we sell by distance contract but are not established.
cases.rationale: States the obligation and states it is unmet. Scoping work planned is not appointment.

cases.evidence_in_document: We do not currently apply eco-modulation criteria such as durability, recyclability, or recycled content.
cases.rationale: Fees are on total weight only. The PRO not having published schedules explains the gap, it does not close it.

cases.evidence_in_document: We do not operate a formal donation-offer step before destruction. Charity donation is attempted informally by the warehouse team where time allows.
cases.rationale: The derogation requires an offer to three social economy entities or eight weeks on the website. Informal best-effort satisfies neither.

cases.evidence_in_document: We have not obtained a qualified electronic seal or qualified electronic signature under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014.
cases.rationale: Verified-economic-operator status is a precondition for registering a DPP and is explicitly absent.

cases.evidence_in_document: No data carrier standard has been selected and we have not registered any product in any Commission registry.
cases.rationale: No registration has taken place.

cases.evidence_in_document: Data is held at style (model) level; we do not currently generate batch-level or item-level identifiers, and our QR codes resolve to a marketing URL rather than to a persistent unique product identifier.
cases.rationale: Model-only identifiers cannot satisfy a batch or item granularity requirement, and the identifier is not persistent.

cases.evidence_in_document: We do not currently include a declaration of fitness for reuse.
cases.rationale: Invoice and transport document are present but the required declaration is explicitly absent.

cases.evidence_in_document: does not break down units or weight of unsold goods discarded, nor the reasons for discarding, nor the split across waste treatment operations.
cases.rationale: The Annex I format is not used at all.

cases.evidence_in_document: Compliance documentation is retained for five years in our document management system.
cases.rationale: Matches the five-year retention duty for delivery and reception documentation.

cases.evidence_in_document: We are registered as a producer in the national producer register in Sweden and in the Netherlands... Registration in France, Germany, Spain and Italy is in progress.
cases.rationale: Registration is required in every Member State of supply. Two done, four outstanding: partially compliant, not compliant.

cases.evidence_in_document: we pay annual fees to the producer responsibility organisation in both markets
cases.rationale: A PRO is entrusted in the two registered markets only, mirroring the registration gap elsewhere.

cases.evidence_in_document: retained for five years... with the exception of Brand Protection case files noted above [retained for three years]
cases.rationale: General retention meets the five-year rule, but the IP-derogation files that Article 3 specifically covers are kept for three. Meets the rule in general and fails it exactly where it bites.

cases.evidence_in_document: employing 1,340 staff with an annual turnover of EUR 310 million
cases.rationale: The provision defers application for enterprises under 10 staff and EUR 2m. Nordvik is far outside that.

cases.evidence_in_document: (no corresponding company obligation)
cases.rationale: Transposition duty addressed to Member States, not to an economic operator.

cases.evidence_in_document: (no corresponding company obligation)
cases.rationale: 'Member States shall ensure that EPR schemes are established' binds Member States.

cases.evidence_in_document: (no corresponding company obligation)
cases.rationale: Compositional survey of municipal waste is a Member State duty.

cases.evidence_in_document: sells through our own retail network, our webshop, and third-party online marketplaces
cases.rationale: The duty binds providers of online platforms. Nordvik sells ON marketplaces but does not operate one, so it is the counterparty, not the addressee. A reviewer could argue 'gap' by conflating the roles, which is exactly why this is marked nuanced.

cases.evidence_in_document: We have begun a Digital Product Passport readiness project with an external consortium.
cases.rationale: The requirement text says outright that no textile delegated act has been adopted, so there is nothing to comply with yet. Scored as not_applicable; 'met' would also be defensible for a firm already preparing, which is why this is nuanced.

cases.evidence_in_document: We are registered in the national register of producers ... in every Member State in which we make Annex IVc products available on the market.
cases.rationale: Registration in every market of supply, reconciled quarterly, with a control preventing market opening before registration.

cases.evidence_in_document: In each of those Member States we have entrusted an authorised producer responsibility organisation ... under written contract.
cases.rationale: A PRO is entrusted in every market, by written contract, with quarterly tonnage reporting.

cases.evidence_in_document: we have appointed an authorised representative by written mandate, and the mandate is filed with the competent national authority.
cases.rationale: Written mandate, filed with the authority, covering every distance-selling market where not established.

cases.evidence_in_document: Our financial contributions are calculated on weight and quantity and are eco-modulated.
cases.rationale: Weight and quantity basis plus modulation on durability, repairability, recycled content and substances of concern, with a technical file per SKU.

cases.evidence_in_document: We cover the costs of separate collection of used and waste products, of transport to sorting, of sorting operations, and of the awareness campaigns.
cases.rationale: The four cost heads the Article lists are each covered under an agreed scope.

cases.evidence_in_document: We do not destroy unsold consumer apparel, clothing accessories or footwear ... enforced by a system control.
cases.rationale: Prohibition adopted ahead of the statutory date and enforced by a hard control on the CN codes in Annex VII.

cases.evidence_in_document: We disclose annually, on our corporate website, the number and total weight of unsold consumer products discarded ... the measures taken and planned to prevent destruction.
cases.rationale: Every element the Article enumerates is disclosed annually.

cases.evidence_in_document: The disclosure follows the format set out in Annex I to Commission Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/2
cases.rationale: The prescribed format is used, and cross-referenced from the management report.

cases.evidence_in_document: is presented per Combined Nomenclature category at four-digit level for the headings listed in Annex II to that Regulation
cases.rationale: Four-digit delimitation applied to exactly the Annex II headings.

cases.evidence_in_document: We retain the information and documentation demonstrating the delivery and reception of discarded unsold consumer products ... for five years following the disclosure.
cases.rationale: Five-year retention including waste treatment operator statements.

cases.evidence_in_document: the applicable ground under Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) 2026/296 is recorded in the case file, together with the evidence required by Article 3
cases.rationale: Destruction only on a recorded Article 2 ground with the Article 3 evidence; the 41 cases cited are all safety or non-compliance grounds.

cases.evidence_in_document: offers the stock directly to at least three social economy entities established in the Union and, in parallel, lists it on a publicly accessible donation page ... for a minimum of eight weeks.
cases.rationale: Both limbs of the donation route are satisfied, and offer records are retained.

cases.evidence_in_document: Case files are retained in electronic form for five years from the date of destruction and can be produced to a competent authority within 30 days of a request.
cases.rationale: Five years, electronic, 30-day production: the three elements the Article requires.

cases.evidence_in_document: Our identity and establishment were evidenced by a qualified electronic seal supported by a qualified certificate issued by a qualified trust service provider under Regulation (EU) No 910/2014.
cases.rationale: Exactly the route Article 4 prescribes for a legal person established in the Union.

cases.evidence_in_document: we register the passport in the Commission registry before the product is placed on the market, at the granularity specified in the applicable delegated act
cases.rationale: Registration by the operator placing the product on the market, at the prescribed granularity.

cases.evidence_in_document: Identifiers are issued at item level, and each item identifier is linked to its batch identifier and to its model identifier
cases.rationale: Item-level identifiers with batch and model linkage, and registration at the most granular level required.

cases.evidence_in_document: We generate and archive the proof of registration for each passport version
cases.rationale: Proof of registration generated and retained per version.

cases.evidence_in_document: we treat the accuracy, completeness and currency of the registered data as an owner obligation ... our responsibility for compliance is unchanged.
cases.rationale: Accuracy and currency owned by a named role, and responsibility retained where a third party acts in the registry.

cases.evidence_in_document: accompanied by a copy of the invoice and the contract stating that the products are destined for and fit for re-use, together with a declaration of fitness for re-use
cases.rationale: Invoice, contract and the declaration the Article requires.

cases.evidence_in_document: our take-back bins currently accept only Meridian-branded products in 94 of the 610 stores
cases.rationale: Collection must accept products regardless of brand. Compliant in 516 stores, non-compliant in 94, and the company says so itself.

cases.evidence_in_document: we do not yet publish the annual figures required of producer responsibility organisations on their own websites
cases.rationale: The publication duty sits on the PRO. Meridian names it as an open gap, but a strict reading makes it not_applicable to the producer. Marked nuanced for that reason.

cases.evidence_in_document: 4,120 employees and consolidated turnover of EUR 1.16 billion
cases.rationale: The micro-enterprise deferral cannot apply at this size.
